command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_conduction_2d.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=/tmp/sph_resistive_decay.xml
reference: Unit length and area, zero end temperatures, two half-length layers with k=C=1 and k=C=3. Sample the initial west and east profiles sin(w*x) and -sin(w*(1-x))/3 at the particle centers, w=3*pi/2. Both decay as exp(-w*w*t). Exponential time integration, with material-side contact temperatures reconstructed from interval mean field and section flux. Errors are maxima over the two windows.
